stories.title: Karnataka High Court orders GBA to pay ₹2.77 crore to man paralysed due to falling of tree branch

en.title: Karnataka High Court orders GBA to pay ₹2.77 crore to man paralysed due to falling of tree branch
en.summary: A Karnataka High Court ruled that the Garden and Parks Authority must compensate a man who became paralysed after a tree branch fell on him, rejecting the authority's claim that the incident was an act of God.

en.summary: Tata Trusts are planning restructuring of Tata Sons to avoid stock market listing requirements. The move comes during a period of tension between Tata Sons and Tata Trusts.

en.summary: Tata Trusts have proposed merging two subsidiaries into Tata Sons to change its regulatory classification and avoid mandatory public listing requirements. The plan requires approval from the Reserve Bank of India.

en.title: Asian Games: India set up blockbuster hockey semifinal vs arch-rivals Pakistan
en.summary: Defending champion India advanced to the hockey semifinal after defeating Bangladesh 10-0, with captain Harmanpreet Singh scoring a hat-trick. They will face Pakistan in the semifinal on October 1.

en.title: Asian Games Medal Tally: India win 8 medals but remain outside top 10
en.summary: India earned eight medals on Day 9 of the Asian Games, comprising four silver and four bronze medals across various sports. With only four gold medals, India remained in 12th place overall.

en.title: Asian Games: Yashvir wins silver, Rohit bronze as Pathirage takes javelin gold

en.title: US stocks: US market drops as Trump's rejection of Iran peace plan lifts oil prices
en.summary: US market indexes declined following President Trump's dismissal of Iran's peace proposal, as crude oil prices surged and raised inflation concerns, pushing Treasury yields higher. Nvidia's stock showed some strength from share repurchase announcements but provided limited support to broader market sentiment.
